DIRECT.definition: A dataset-native operational field has the same decision-relevant semantic meaning as the recovery-state variable and supplies its value at the required decision time without substantive inference.

DERIVABLE_BY_PREDECLARED_RULE.definition: One or more dataset-native operational fields deterministically establish the recovery-state variable through a rule written and source-justified before row-level endpoint inspection.
requirements: the exact source fields are named
the derivation rule is executable or unambiguous
the rule does not use attack or scenario ground-truth labels
the rule does not depend on hidden mission state
the rule does not infer semantics from statistical association alone
the rule has an explicit rationale tied to dataset documentation or a governing technical definition

AMBIGUOUS.definition: Dataset-native information constrains or relates to the recovery-state variable but does not uniquely determine its decision-relevant value.
examples: a timestamp exists but no trusted reference establishes freshness at the recovery decision point
a source identifier exists but does not establish source trust
an error counter suggests degraded evidence but does not establish minimum evidence completeness
a CRC outcome constrains frame integrity but does not establish cryptographic signature validity

ABSENT.definition: No dataset-native operational field or permitted predeclared derivation provides decision-relevant information for the recovery-state variable.
ABSENT.rule: Absence is a valid result and must not be repaired by imputation.

frozen_target_semantics.signature_valid: cryptographic signature verification outcome under a known source public key
frozen_target_semantics.source_trusted: membership of the evidence source in the verifier's trusted-source set
frozen_target_semantics.fresh: evidence issue time and validity interval contain the decision time
frozen_target_semantics.epoch_valid: evidence epoch equals the expected epoch for the subject
frozen_target_semantics.contradictory: accepted current claims for the same subject, key, and epoch contain competing values
frozen_target_semantics.minimum_evidence_complete: all ten frozen recovery criteria are present in the current accepted evidence state
frozen_target_semantics.security_signal: dataset-native operational security or anomaly guard signal visible to the selector, excluding offline attack truth
frozen_target_semantics.authorization_available: authorization or authorized-contact path required by the recovery decision is available at the decision point

derivation_registry_rule: The primary semantic mapping may not use a deterministic derivation unless it appears in the frozen semantic-adjudication record. The registry is intentionally empty.

frozen_direct_rule_exceptions.basis: Pinned UNSW feature documentation defines Position_Anomaly as a native computed 0/1 coarse position-spoofing guard.
frozen_direct_rule_exceptions.claim_boundary: This mapping does not establish attack truth, detector accuracy, or general attack coverage.

coverage_rules.direct_coverage_numerator: count of required recovery-state variables classified DIRECT with evidence_visibility_role=OPERATIONAL_NATIVE
coverage_rules.direct_or_derivable_coverage_numerator: count classified DIRECT or DERIVABLE_BY_PREDECLARED_RULE with evidence_visibility_role=OPERATIONAL_NATIVE

adjudication_rules: lexical similarity between a dataset field and a recovery variable is insufficient by itself
an attack label cannot establish security_signal for a primary operational endpoint because the label is offline ground truth
a documented native detector or security-guard flag may establish security_signal when the field itself expresses the operational signal and requires only allowed normalization
a source address or identifier does not establish source_trusted unless trust is itself represented or deterministically established by a frozen rule
a CRC, checksum, or generic error counter does not establish signature_valid
a timestamp does not establish fresh without a decision-time reference and validity rule
a version, TLE epoch, or sequence number does not establish epoch_valid without an expected evidence epoch and comparison rule
multiple apparently inconsistent native fields do not establish contradictory unless the same-subject/same-key/same-epoch competing-claim relation is represented
presence of telemetry or a quality score does not establish minimum_evidence_complete
normal or attack scenario membership does not establish authorization_available
presence of a command or command code does not establish authorization_available
when evidence supports more than one plausible class, choose the less assertive class and preserve the ambiguity rationale
quality_controls: all primary population identities are frozen before canonical mapping
all semantic contracts and permitted derivation rules are frozen before row-level endpoint inspection
mapping output must be machine-checkable against the frozen schema manifest
every DIRECT or DERIVABLE mapping must reference at least one qualifying native field
every DERIVABLE mapping must include a nonempty rule present in the frozen derivation registry
every AMBIGUOUS mapping must state why the value is not uniquely determined
every ABSENT mapping must be reproducible from the frozen schema inventory
a separately implemented audit should reconstruct mapping counts and downstream admissible-action calculations without reading canonical result files
prohibited_claims_from_mapping_alone: external validation of the frozen recovery policy
superiority of one dataset, detector, policy, or AI method
